trap.label: had been
trap.wrong: Had this taught earlier, students would understand it.
trap.right: Had this been taught earlier, students would understand it.
trap.why: Em português “se isto tivesse sido ensinado” tem duas partes e o aluno omite been. Em inglês, passiva em inversão: Had + been + pp.
